title: inventory_events
description: One row per thing that happened to an item: added, updated (with the change list), assigned, unassigned, asked to collect / hand in, receipt requested / signed, collected / not collected, handed back. "Added", "Assigned" and "Expired" are also derived from the item on read and never stored twice.

kind.description: Activity vocabulary shared with the rest of the app.

title.description: Overrides the kind's label ("Assigned to driver", "Receipt signed").

detail.description: "Status: Active → Expiring Soon", "Taken back from Jason Cooper".

changes.description: For updates: `{ field, from, to }` rows.

byName.description: Display name at the time ("Kenan Gain").

collectionId.description: → `inventory_collections._id` when the event came from a card.
